about: Check-in chat replies for check-society-suggestions.mjs. Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

gigs, rules out sport.message: Gigs and live music. Not sport. A gig, then out with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gigs, rules out sport.reply: If you are into live music, you might like [[Music]], [[Rock]], or [[Vocaloid]]. You can also check out [[Gigs]] for what is coming up at the Students' Union. Is there anything you would like to add to your [[Checklist]] while you get settled?

homebody, rules out partying.message: Board games and reading. Not partying. A quiet night in with a film. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
homebody, rules out partying.reply: For a quiet night in with a film, [[Film]] is a great one to check out. Since you enjoy board games and reading, you might also like [[Gaming and Roleplay]] and [[Book]].

sporty early riser.message: Football and the gym. Up early for a run, then football. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
sporty early riser.reply: For football, check out the [[Football]] club for training and matches. Would you like anything added to your [[Checklist]] while you settle in?

lie-in and the cinema.message: Photography and the cinema. A lie-in, then the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
lie-in and the cinema.reply: [[Film]] is a great choice if you enjoy watching and talking about movies. You could also take a look at [[Art]] for photography and creative projects.

gamer, last minute (near tie).message: Gaming, Minecraft and FIFA. Gaming online late with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gamer, last minute (near tie).reply: Check out [[Gaming and Roleplay]] for all kinds of games, and [[Esports]] if you fancy competitive gaming.

clubbing (synonyms for partying).message: Going clubbing and festivals. Big nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
clubbing (synonyms for partying).reply: For great nights out, you might enjoy [[Events]] and [[Gigs]] to see what is coming up.

outdoors, rules out the gym.message: Hiking and climbing. Not the gym. Up early for a long walk. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
outdoors, rules out the gym.reply: For long walks, [[Walking]] is a great choice.

unrelated to every mentor.message: Knitting and birdwatching. A trip to a nature reserve. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
unrelated to every mentor.reply: For knitting, you might like [[Hooked By Crochet]] or [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]] since they are both great for craft and handwork.

only says what they don't want in 3 answ.message: I'm not into sport, clubbing or gaming. I don't like loud nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
only says what they don't want in 3 answ.reply: It is good to know what you prefer to avoid. Could you tell me a bit about what you do enjoy so I can suggest a society that fits you?

quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.message: Reading and films. Quiet nights in, not nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.reply: For quiet nights in, [[Book]] and [[Film]] are great societies to check out.

live music (synonym for gigs).message: Live music, mostly indie bands. Seeing a band, then drinks with friends. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
live music (synonym for gigs).reply: For live music and going out, you might enjoy [[Rock]] or [[Music]]. Have you thought about anything else you'd like added to your [[Checklist]] while you settle in?

interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.message: I'm not Ukrainian, but I'd love to learn more about Ukrainian culture and meet people. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.reply: You would fit right in at [[Ukrainian]], as everyone is welcome to join and learn more about the culture.

a mature student.message: I'm a mature student, so I'm a bit older than most people on my course. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a mature student.reply: You might like [[Mature Students]], which is a welcoming space for students who are a bit older.

worried about money.message: I'm really worried about money. My loan won't last until the end of term and I don't know what to do.
worried about money.reply: I am really sorry to hear you are feeling stressed about money, but there is support available. You can take a look at [[Cost of Living]] and [[Food Pantry]] to see how they can help with food and money worries.

run out of money for food.message: I've run out of money for food this week and I'm not sure what to do.
run out of money for food.reply: I am really sorry to hear that you are going through this. You can get help with food and money worries through [[Food Pantry]] and [[Cost of Living]].

accused of plagiarism.message: I've been accused of plagiarism in one of my essays and I'm panicking.
accused of plagiarism.reply: I am so sorry you are going through that, but please try not to panic. You can get support and guidance from the [[Advice Centre]] with academic appeals and misconduct.

landlord won't fix the damp.message: My landlord won't fix the damp in my flat and keeps ignoring my messages. Can I complain?
landlord won't fix the damp.reply: Yes, you can certainly raise a complaint about that. The [[Advice Centre]] can guide you on housing issues and how to handle landlords who ignore repairs.

swims a lot.message: I swim a lot and I'd like to keep it up while I'm here. Any clubs or societies?
swims a lot.reply: Check out [[Swimming]] for training times and memberships. Is there anything else you would like reminding about for your checklist?

played football at school.message: I played football at school and I'd like to start playing again. Where should I look?
played football at school.reply: You can take a look at [[Football]] for the university's sports club details, memberships and training times.

into ice hockey.message: I'm really into ice hockey. Is there anything for me here?
into ice hockey.reply: That is fantastic, because [[Ice Hockey]] is a great society here to get involved with.

never done sport, wants to get fit.message: I've never really done any sport, but I want to get fitter this year. Any ideas?
never done sport, wants to get fit.reply: If you want to build up your fitness without team pressure, [[Pilates]] and [[Yoga]] are great options for working out at your own pace. You could also check out [[Sport]] to see all the individual classes and activities Northumbria Sport offers.

do I pay to see a doctor.message: I'm an international student. Do I have to pay to see a doctor here?
do I pay to see a doctor.reply: You do not usually have to pay to see a doctor through the NHS once you have paid your immigration health surcharge. The [[NHS Guide]] has more details and official sources.

how does the NHS work.message: I've just arrived from abroad and I don't understand how the NHS works. Can you explain?
how does the NHS work.reply: The NHS is the UK's health service, and most basic care is free, though you might pay for prescriptions and dental treatment. Have a look at the [[NHS Guide]] for all the details on how it works and how to register.

how to contact a suggested society.first: I love knitting and crochet. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to contact a suggested society.firstReply: [[Hooked By Crochet]] and [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]] are both great choices for crafts like yours.
how to contact a suggested society.thenReply: [[Hooked By Crochet]] has how to join and who to contact.

how to join a suggested society.first: I'm really into climbing and bouldering. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to join a suggested society.firstReply: [[Climbing]] is a great fit for your interest in bouldering.
how to join a suggested society.thenReply: [[Climbing]] has how to join and who to contact.

what a suggested society is like.first: I like board games and tabletop role-playing games. Are there any societies for that?
what a suggested society is like.firstReply: [[Gaming and Roleplay]] is a great choice for board games and tabletop roleplaying. Have you had a chance to look at anything else yet, or is there anything you would like added to your [[Checklist]]?
what a suggested society is like.thenReply: [[Gaming and Roleplay]] has how to join and who to contact.

a suggested society's Instagram.first: I love films and going to the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a suggested society's Instagram.firstReply: If you enjoy films, you might like [[Film]] for movie nights or [[Film & TV Production]] if you are interested in making them.
a suggested society's Instagram.thenReply: [[Film]] has how to join and who to contact.
